seoTitle: YouTube Earnings Estimator from Views and RPM
metaDescription: Estimate monthly and yearly YouTube ad revenue from your views and an RPM range from your own Studio data. Free, private.
intro: Estimate monthly and yearly YouTube ad revenue from views and an RPM range you enter from your own YouTube Studio.
why:
Revenue estimates online use a made-up RPM. Your real RPM is in YouTube Studio, and it varies by niche, country, season and video length.

Enter your monthly views and a low and high RPM. The tool shows the low, middle and high income per month and per year, and lets you take off a share for costs or fees. RPM is paid per 1,000 views of all your views, after YouTube's cut, so it is lower than CPM. Sponsorships and memberships are not included.
howTo: Enter low and high RPM from YouTube Studio.

faq.a: Revenue per 1,000 views, after YouTube's share. CPM is per 1,000 ad impressions.
Your own, from analytics. The defaults are placeholders.
They have a different payout. Enter Shorts views separately with their own RPM.
